title: Airbnb vs. Spotify Technology: Which Consumer Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
author: Pamela Kock
description: The article compares Airbnb and Spotify Technology as investment options for 2026. Both companies have achieved profitability with similar leverage ratios (0.3x debt-to-equity), but differ significantly in margins and valuations. Airbnb generated $12.2B in revenue with a 20.5% net margin and $4.6B in free cash flow, while Spotify achieved $20.1B in revenue with a 12.9% net margin and $3.4B in free cash flow. The author recommends Airbnb due to its asset-light marketplace model, stronger profitability, capital efficiency, and more resilient growth potential, despite both facing competitive and regulatory challenges.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong net margin of 20.5%, robust free cash flow of $4.6B, asset-light scalable model, healthy balance sheet (1.4x current ratio), and recommended as the better buy despite regulatory risks and competition from Booking Holdings.

title: 3 Alger Mutual Funds Offering Exposure to Growth Stocks
author: Na
description: Zacks highlights three Alger mutual funds with strong ratings and positive long-term returns. Alger Focus Equity (ALGRX) holds concentrated positions in tech leaders with 35.6% 3-year returns, Alger Growth & Income (ALBAX) targets dividend-paying large-cap stocks with 20.2% 3-year returns, and Alger Responsible Investing (AGIFX) focuses on ESG-rated companies with growth potential. All three funds maintain low expense ratios and minimum investments under $5,000, positioning them to benefit from AI, business investment, and structural growth trends.
